duas.title: At iftar (breaking fast)
duas.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Dhahaba az-zama'u wabtallatil-'urooqu wa thabatal-ajru in sha Allah
duas.english: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

duas.title: Goodness in both worlds
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar
duas.english: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.title: Sufficiency of Allah
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs.

duas.title: Increase in knowledge
duas.english: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.title: Relief from anxiety and sorrow
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow.

duas.title: Morning remembrance
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur
duas.english: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

duas.title: Before sleeping
duas.english: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.title: Steadfastness of the heart
duas.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
duas.english: O Turner of the hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.

duas.title: Seeking forgiveness
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa tub 'alayya innaka antat-Tawwabur-Raheem
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance; indeed You are the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful.

duas.title: The best of character
duas.english: O Allah, guide me to the best of character.
